related: RNA polymerase III type 1 promoter DNA binding

definition: Binding to a sequence of DNA that is a part of a type 1 promoter that controls transcription by RNA polymerase III. Type 1 promoters are found in 5S rRNA genes, downstream of the transcription start site within the sequence of the mature RNA, and require TFIIIA for recognition.
label: RNA polymerase III type 1 promoter sequence-specific DNA binding
